items.say: Puff the dragon spent the morning at the village market. First, he bought a mushroom. Next, he waved a flag. After that, he tried on a hat. Finally, he tapped on a drum. What did Puff do right before he waved the flag?

Puff the dragon put on a magic show for the whole village. First, he bent a key in half. Next, he made a ring spin in the air. After that, he pulled a rabbit out of a hat. Finally, he made a coin vanish. What did Puff do right after he bent the key in half?

Pounce the cat put on a magic show for the whole village. First, she bent a key in half. Then she made a coin vanish. After that, she made a ring spin in the air. Last of all, she made a star glow. What was the second thing Pounce did?

It was cleaning day at the castle, and Puff the dragon had a lot to do. First, he put away the torch. Then he washed the boot. After that, he dusted the chest. Last of all, he shined the crown. What did Puff do after he washed the boot but before he shined the crown?

Sir Clank the knight was getting ready for the big parade. To start with, he painted the shield. Next, he brushed the hat. Then he cleaned the muddy boot. At the very end, he rang the bell. What did Sir Clank do right before he brushed the hat?
